chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Hilal, from Uqba ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the woman who gives birth on the Day of Arafaat, what should she do with her child? Should Tawaaf be performed on its behalf, or what should be done with it? He (peace be upon him) said: There is nothing upon it.
ai.seo_question: Does a newborn baby need to perform Tawaaf if born during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that a newborn born on the Day of Arafah is exempt from performing Tawaaf individually, as the obligation of pilgrimage rituals applies only to those who have reached the age of religious maturity (bulugh). This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that infants are not burdened with specific ritual acts like Tawaaf, distinguishing their status from the pilgrim themselves. The narration highlights the practical application of fiqh during the peak of the Hajj season, ensuring clarity for families performing Umrah or Hajj.
